pages.title: Waystone paths
pages.text: Sneak-use a compass on the top of a solid floor to bind a landing. Use it to return. Keep two clear dry blocks above the floor. A blocked landing refuses and spends nothing; Pulse is taken only after the floor is clear and dry. Power the landing floor with redstone to lock arrival.

pages.title: Travel tiers
pages.text: Waystone Compass: 128 blocks, same world, 20 Pulse. Horizon Compass: any distance in one world, 40 Pulse. Astral Compass: across dimensions, 100 Pulse. Travel has a 5-second cooldown.

pages.title: The March
pages.text: The Gate Drum is a charged portal, not a Drumheart. A Pulse Cell adds up to 25 Pulse each use; sneak empty-handed adds 5. The drum holds 200. Empty-handed use spends 20 stored Pulse and walks you through. Redstone locks the drum. A blocked landing refunds that 20. Bind a return compass first. March materials unlock Astral transport, the Loom voice, and the last of the tablets. A Way Gate lights at 400 Pulse of 600 and spends 20 to travel, with a one-second cooldown. A Far Gate lights at 1,200 Pulse of 2,000 and spends 120 to travel, with a two-second cooldown.

pages.title: The veil at night
pages.text: After dusk, the sky unfolds in slow curtains of green and violet. The March carries a colder sky. Rain veils the aurora. Client settings can reduce its detail or disable it for shader packs.

pages.title: Gentle harvesting
pages.text: Brush adult Dawn Stags, Lantern Foxes and Mossbacks for renewable reagents. Each rests for one minute between harvests. Young animals do not yield materials. Breed with wheat, sweet berries and seagrass respectively.

pages.title: Broken guardians
pages.text: Ashbound, Rootbound and Reed Stalkers haunt forests and marshes in the Overworld. All can also be found in the March. Build lighted paths: hostile creatures require darkness.

pages.title: Beyond the Gate
pages.text: Steppe: Dawn Stags, rabbits, Ashbound, Rootbound, Rift Hounds, Echo Weavers, Ancestor Halls. Highlands: Drum Circles, The Unsung, Hollow Sentinels, Storm Moths, Cinder Imps. Crystal Fields: the Loom-stitcher spire, Lantern Foxes, Shardbacks, Mourning Bells. Snow Fields: foxes, rabbits, polar bears. Ember Wastes: sparse fire country. Reed Fen: frogs, fish, Reed Stalkers. Bind a return compass.

pages.title: Answering a spell
pages.text: Storm Moths, Cinder Imps and Mourning Bells gather visible motes before casting. Step behind solid cover to interrupt. Their magic never burns or replaces terrain. A charged staff is useful for keeping distance.

pages.title: Returning the song
pages.text: Bring creature reagents to the Echo workshops. Gentle animal harvests, Storm Wings and Echo Silk bind into Spiritweave under Water. Other hostile remnants attune into two Attuned Echoes under Spirit. Existing recipes remain available.

pages.title: Drum Circle
pages.text: Twelve lantern-topped pillars ring a Silent Drum in the March highlands. Strike empty-handed or with a Bone Chime: four beats about a second apart (16 to 28 ticks). A wrong beat thuds and resets. Each drum answers once per twenty minutes of real time, and never while its keeper is already awake.

pages.title: The Unsung
pages.text: Beat (above two thirds): a shockwave every 3 seconds hits everyone within 8 blocks for 6 and knocks back. Sneak to brace for half damage and no knockback. Its swipe deals 10. Chorus: every 8 seconds it calls two Echo Weavers, up to six, and shockwaves every 2.5 seconds. Silence (below one third): invulnerable over the drum, slow weaving bolts. Play the four-beat on the Silent Drum to resync: stunned 8 seconds at double damage. Silence returns 12 seconds after each resync. Leave for 30 seconds and it resets.
